snippet.title: Duck Detective: the Ghost of Glamping - Date Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
The new Duck Detective is releasing on May 22nd 2025!
Coming to Steam, GOG, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, Playstation.

You are the one and only Duck Detective, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2714620/Duck_Detective_The_Ghost_of_Glamping/
